allow.reason: Public contact and waitlist form: honeypot, size caps and 5 requests per IP per hour; writes only to site_requests.
Self-Heal startup check: names missing config, never values; no provider call, no user data.
Self-Heal error and Report a problem relay: anonymous by design, 5 reports per IP per minute, scrubbed text only.
Exchanges the shared media access code for a signed cookie; checks MEDIA_ACCESS_CODE itself.
Re-checks the signed media cookie (lib/media-auth.js isAuthed) before serving any file; whitelist of fixed names.
Defender extension's anonymous report relay (smartplay-cybersecurity selfheal.ts): answers only chrome-extension origins, 5 per IP per minute, scrubbed allow-listed fields only.
Public pilot request form (pilot.html): honeypot, 10 per IP and 3 per email per day via the atomic rate slot; writes only pilot_requests.
Public try-code form (js/try-form.js): honeypot, 10 per IP and 3 per email per day via the atomic rate slot; issues a free 30-day code only.
Shared try-code check for SmartMotion and SmartBay: the code is the credential; owner bypass is decided by Caddie's throttled owner-verify, never here.
Helpers, not handlers: media-auth and the Self-Heal relay are called by the routes above.
